ctx.x: Who else? Another boy from New Orleans.

No. But anyway, this trumpet player, me and him was in the bar and Fate come in and this boy, "Hey, Chief, come here, I want you to meet somebody." So that's how I met him. And he was such a pleasant guy from then on. He was my drinking man, because he used to ask me a lot of questions about the band and -- Fate Marable, him and his gin. We was close.
